collection.name: Brothers Grimm
collection.description: Collection of tales and characters inspired by the Brothers Grimm.

info.name: El Burro del Molino
info.ability: Each night, choose a player and add Music. If they already had Music from another source, learn their team.

effects.prompt: Añade Música. Si el objetivo ya tenía Música de otra fuente, muestra su equipo.

info.name: El Gallo del Corral
info.ability: Each night, choose a player and add Music. If they already had Music from another source, learn whether they are Good or Evil.

effects.prompt: Añade Música. Si el objetivo ya tenía Música de otra fuente, muestra si es Bueno o Malo.

info.name: El Censista
info.ability: Each night, choose a player and learn how many living players share their team.

info.name: El Notario
info.ability: Once per game, when a player is executed, learn the nominator's team.

effects.prompt: Una vez por partida, cuando un jugador es ejecutado, conoces el equipo del jugador que lo nominó.

info.name: El Perro de Caza
info.ability: Each night, choose a player and add Music. They cannot die that night; if no death would have reached them, you cannot vote the next day.

effects.prompt: Añade Música y protege al objetivo esta noche. Si ninguna muerte iba a alcanzarlo, marca al Perro sin voto para el día siguiente.

info.name: La Gata del Fogón
info.ability: Each night, choose a player and add Music. If they already had Music from another source, the Storyteller moves one of their negative markers to another living player.

effects.prompt: Añade Música. Si ya tenía Música de otra fuente, mueve una ficha negativa transferible suya a otro jugador vivo elegido por el Narrador.

info.name: La Partera
info.ability: Once per game, when a player would die, they become Excluded until the next dawn instead.

effects.prompt: Una vez por partida, cuando un jugador fuera a morir, en su lugar queda Excluido hasta el amanecer siguiente.

info.name: Charm Thief
info.ability: Each night, choose another player, then a different player, who may be you. Every active transferable protection moves from the first player to the second. You do not learn whether any moved.

characters.icon: <svg viewBox="0 0 128 128" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><circle cx="64" cy="30" r="16" fill="#a28d73" stroke="#ead8b6" stroke-width="5"/><path d="M43 52c10-8 32-8 42 0l10 30-18 7-4 25H55l-4-25-18-7z" fill="#745136" stroke="#ead8b6" stroke-width="5" stroke-linejoin="round"/><path d="m31 27 66 74M96 25 34 101" stroke="#b96b5b" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>

info.name: Hex Dollmaker
info.ability: You begin holding a Voodoo Doll. Each night, you may keep it or pass it once to another living player, who does not know. When the third death occurs, its holder dies; if they are the Demon, you die instead.

dollAction.question: Do they keep or pass the Doll?

info.name: El Campanero de Bremen
info.ability: Once per game, before a nomination, you may sound the alarm: every vote on that nomination counts double.

effects.prompt: Antes de una nominación, declara alarma y cuenta doble todos sus votos.

info.name: El Capitán de los Ladrones
info.ability: Each night, choose a player: copy their real ability until dawn and they cannot use it that night.

effects.prompt: Elige a un jugador. Copia su habilidad real hasta el amanecer y restringe su habilidad esta noche.

info.name: El Ladrón Explorador
info.ability: Each night, choose a player and learn whether they have any active protection. If the {{team:grimm:oscuro}} dies, you lose this ability.

info.name: El Ladrón de la Chimenea
info.ability: Each night, choose a player: the first Music they would receive that night is removed. If the {{team:grimm:oscuro}} dies, you lose this ability.

effects.prompt: Elige a un jugador. Retira la primera Música que fuera a recibir esta noche, si el Oscuro sigue vivo.

info.name: El Molinero que Abandona
info.ability: Each night, choose a player and learn whether they used an ability. You win if you survive after choosing both a Town player and a {{team:grimm:oscuro}} who did.

info.name: El Cazador que Abandona
info.ability: Each night, protect a player from death caused by an Evil player. You win if you survive after protecting a {{team:grimm:siervo}}.

effects.prompt: Elige a un jugador y protégelo esta noche de una muerte causada por un Malvado; registra si es Siervo.

info.name: Extended composition
info.ability: Extended Grimm distribution for games with 7 to 15 players.

gameRules.summaryEs: Distribución Grimm extendida para partidas de 7 a 15 jugadores.

text.name: Los Músicos de Bremen
text.description: Cuatro animales abandonados unen su música para conquistar una casa ocupada por ladrones.

nightInstructions.opening: Comprueba que todos tienen los ojos cerrados y resuelve el orden nocturno.
nightInstructions.dawn: Retira efectos caducados, anuncia muertes y entrega la información pendiente.

elements.label: Música
elements.description: Marca acumulable por fuente que activa bonificaciones cuando ya estaba presente.
